name: Valmet PS-21 / PM3 — SML Shotton Paper Machine 3

agitator_rotor.note: Rotor sub-equipment of agitator/pulper — decimal suffix variant e.g. 35-24L009.1, 35-24L009.2. Motor tag strips the letter but keeps decimal: 35-24L009.1 → 35-24-009.1

fimpec_valve_codes._note: Appendix II of PS-21. These codes appear as a hyphen-separated suffix on manual valve tags (e.g. 35-24-123-GLO). The pipeline classifies via CAD layer + vision of the P&ID symbol shape, not by reading the tag suffix. FIMPEC codes are recorded here for reference only.
fimpec_valve_codes._pipeline_use: not used — vision classifies the symbol, not the tag text

BAL.pid_symbol: NC or HV bowtie (solid or outline)

BUT.pid_symbol: NC or HV bowtie (solid or outline)

GLO.pid_symbol: Outline bowtie with small circle at triangle junction

GAT.pid_symbol: NC or HV bowtie (solid or outline)

notes: L401–L499 = agitator (PM3 number-series convention). L001–L399 = process equipment / pipeline. P-CVPOS layer → automatic/control valve (AV type in SML nomenclature). P-VALVEPOS layer → hand valve. Appendix III sub-process codes (22=approach flow, 24=broke) define the pipe tag prefix but are in a scanned table in the PDF — not machine-readable. FIMPEC codes (Appendix II) are tag suffixes on manual valves; only GLO→GLV, CHS/CHD→CHK, STR→YSTR have an unambiguous P&ID symbol mapping — the rest (BAL, BUT, FBV, GAT) share the plain bowtie symbol so the code does not disambiguate between NC and HV.
